items.note: The plan gives the eight-row cancel/introduce/restore schedule, the net change (JV+RG)x independent of a,c, the central coefficients |S∩T| mod 2 and (|S∩T|-1)/2 with side cancellation, and the three stages (x,y)->(x,y+x)->(-y,y+x)->(-y,x), as in 741-765. It omits h=100, the explicit neighbour rules and the wire counts (767-782), but the lemma itself does not need them.

The plan has the invariant 'stored = D_v applied to the logical array', the edge operator D_vD_u^{-1}, the commuting of a common frame with a pointwise gate, D_out S_Omega D_in^{-1}, and the route operator eps_w D_sink(rho(w)) D_source(w)^{-1}. This matches 804-825.

Correctly stated: nested nondegenerate labels built from triple indicator lines, the only decrease on central 3->4 of size h, L=Ich, the sum Wm-2N+2L and the ratios 100/539 and 101/539. The derivation follows the telescoping count (1066-1071), but the stage-by-stage label table is only summarized, and the lemma's claim that every binary residual has an orthonormal basis (1008-1009, 1073-1102) is never stated or derived.

The rank sum s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b<W_b m is stated and derived (rank = dimension change except the N edges 2P_{U_a} of rank one). The assignment of P_U to gates and sinks and -P_{U_a} to sources is only implicit. The endpoint identity M_sink(rho(w))-M_source(w)=I_m appears only as 'the endpoint condition gives Phi_{I_m}', without its derivation P_{U_a^perp}+P_{U_a}=I (1169-1171).

The plan states the frame C_U=H^{⊗m} diag(i^{wt(P_U x)}) H^{⊗m} and one kernel aI+bX_v (or its inverse) per orthonormal residual vector, and cites additivity of weight mod 4. It omits the count s_c=W_c m-2N+2L_c<W_c m and the conclusion that after the diagonal corrections every role receives C^{⊗m}. The proof at 1231-1315, including the 27-coordinate Z correction, is not reconstructed.

For the bit network the plan derives L/N=100/539<1/2, the deficit N-2L_b>0, eta_b=339/22587335000000>20·2^{-50} and m^{1-2^{-50}}>m(1-20·2^{-50})>m(1-eta), giving s/W<m^tau, as at 1331-1343. The complex side (s_c<W_c m, eta_c, sigma) is not stated; S2.3.5 only assumes s/W<=m^sigma. The inequality log m<20 is used but not stated.

The plan invokes 'controlled shifts', 'an elementary stream operation' and the O(V) cost of triangular updates. It never states the lemmas' content: digit permutations, moves, split/merge, cyclic row split, and controlled updates y->y+a mod q^b.

Follows the paper exactly: the topmost-row, rightmost-pivot elimination giving A=E_1 Pi E_2, triangular transforms in descending order in O(V), and each one of Pi realized by D_j<-D_j+H_i, one interchange, D_j<-H_i-D_j, for a interchanges in all.

The plan covers the cyclic split into W role streams of volume V/W, the Phi_M frames giving Phi_{I_m}, the interchange by D<-D-H, H<-H+D, D<-H-D, s calls, F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1), the geometric sum for a<=1 and a>1, and the fixed-tape parking schedule costing O(V). All of this matches 1491-1588.

The plan has the high digits supplying rows, the base-m pieces with cost O(V) sum a_j m^{j tau}=O(Ve^tau), and the padding from [2^u] to [q^e]. It does not mention padding the row count up to a multiple of W^k (1684-1690), which the power-width hypothesis needs; S1.2 only says 'at least W^k rows'. It also omits the unequal-width case (1740-1762).

Present: the identities for C, one forward child per kernel through (C^{-1})^{⊗f}=(-i)^f Z^{⊗f} C^{⊗f} Z^{⊗f}, GL(m,F_2) as a product of row additions, exactly s_c children on f=e/m axes, and H_0^{⊗D}=b^D S_D C^{⊗D} S_D. Missing: the conjugation P_M X_v P_M^{-1}=X_{Mv}, and the endpoint Z_{a,f} and i^{27f} corrections that make the network give C^{⊗e} on every role (1907-1913).

Follows 2013-2208: the parity cycles (00 01 10) and (01 10 11) composing to (00 10)(01 11), the guard interval and bad set, delta_bad=min{1,80(f-1)2^{-K}}, T_0 S_0^{-1} permuting B, swap-rotate-unswap, radix-sort repair, and the stated time bound.

Matches 2286-2448: node overhead O(V((eK)^tau+1)), q_0 preprocessed chunks as the row index with range at least W^{k_0}, child volume V/W, F(e)<=(s/W)F(e/m)+O((eK)^tau+1) with leaves O(e), the internal and leaf sums, and the base-m pieces giving O(d^{lambda'}).

The plan gives the O(Vd^{lambda'}) layer that stays exact until one truncation. It derives the guard widths (A(e)<=sA(e/m)+E, depth-to-bits induction, p+Delta and Delta+3 bits, Delta=o(p)) and the final row-sum-one disk and truncation-error argument, as in 2479-2586 and 2741-2757.

Covered: character cancellation by the y^{rj_0}=-1 shift, the DIF step, bit-reversed storage B_t, the reverse procedure using H_0^2=I/2, round grouping into a butterfly plus J_E, the layout costs O(TpdK) and O(Tp pK^{tau-1}), the simultaneous rounds and the error sqrt2 l 2^{-p}. All match the cited lines.

The plan has evaluation at B_0=2^{4p}, the four products, the separation |h_j|<=r2^{2p}<2^{3p}<B_0/2, centered residues with carry in {0,1}, the negacyclic wrap with |H_j|<=r2^{2p} and the shift by p+l, and the cost O(rp log(rp)), all as at 3233-3368.
Matches 3414-3495: the retained LB order, the normalization MF^+((F^-f)(F^-g)/r)=(f*g)/(rM), P(LBu,LBv)=LB P(u,v), the error 3delta+eta scaled by M to sqrt2 M(3l+1)2^{-p}, and the cost.

Correct on the HvdH identity, invertibility of N, the normalizations with product 2^{-2alpha^2}, the permutations retained instead of sorted, the tensor form with gamma=2d alpha^2, and the line cost O(dTp^{3/2+delta}alpha). The tensor lemma's axis exposure and restoration cost O(Tp d^2(1+l^tau)) and the linewise padded-box procedure (3836-3897) are not covered.

Both identities are stated and the paper's proof route is followed: the coefficient read-off, F_q^+R_c=R_c^{-1}F_q^+ with RF_s^+R=F_s^+, and the normalized convolution rule. The chirp is never defined (a_j=exp(-pi i sum s_i j_i^2/t_i) is missing), and the conjugation construction of RF_s^+ is omitted.

Exponents, sizes, alpha and gamma bounds, the prime-interval count, disjoint intervals, the Bernoulli bound T/2<S<T, alpha^4 theta_i>p, the n^{o(1)} search and the no-wraparound degree bound all match the cited lines.

The plan gives the isomorphism x->prod x_i^{mu_i}, the triangular formula b_i=a_i+mu_i sum_{j<i} a_j P_j, updates in descending order, padding preserved, prefix-controlled cyclic shifts, and the cost O(Tp d^2(1+l^tau)), as in the paper.

Covered: the well-definedness (zeta y)^r=1, the diagonal isometric isomorphism, the wrap check zeta^{k+l}(-1)^h=zeta^j, M_C=D_- iota^{-1} M_r(iota D_+ f, iota D_+ g)=(f*g)/T, and the computed twists with error below 2·2^{-p}.

The source transform (A, chirp transform, B_0, 2^gamma, with exact counterpart RF_s), the six steps and the role of the two S scales follow 4456-4544. The digit scaling by 2^{-b-2}, which the factor 2^{2b+4} undoes, and the definition of F^+ by conjugation are missing.

Follows the paper's chain: the .7/.701 ring margin, E_s=9·2^gamma TL, the (3E_s+2) opposite-transform error from permutation cancellation, the final bound 448b 2^{-3b/4}<1/2 using S<=T<2^b, L<b and gamma<=b/4, rounding, carries and the 2n-bit output. The intermediate bounds E_ring<5TL and chirp<8TL are only implicit.
Reproduces the cost table rows, the margins g_1..g_7, min g_i=2^{-181}=2kappa, the o(V) setup, absorption of powers of log p into p^kappa, and the schoolbook cutoff.
S0 says the bound refutes the n log n conjecture in this model but gives no content: neither the eventual lower bound for every machine nor the liminf T_A(n)/(n lg n)=0 negation.

errors.says: Method: each one of Pi is realised by 'three updates around a single interchange'.
errors.paper: Each one of Pi is implemented by two controlled updates around one interchange: D_j<-D_j+H_i, (H_i,D_j)<-(D_j,H_i), D_j<-H_i-D_j (1435-1443). The plan's own S1.1.5.4 states this correctly.

errors.says: The packed selected-bit addition takes O(V(L^tau+1)) 'plus terms that vanish when K/log p->infty'.
errors.paper: The extra terms are MA^3 and delta_bad MA(R+A). The first vanishes relative to V only because R exceeds every fixed polynomial in p; K/log p->infty controls only the delta_bad term (2004-2009, 2203-2207). S2.2.8 states this correctly.

chain: The tree reaches the main bound by the paper's route: interchange recursion (S1) and simultaneous layer (S2), then transform layout (S3), ring convolution (S4), resampling and chirp (S5), algorithm and exact recovery (S6), and cost table (S7). Each link is supported by correctly quoted steps. The chain thins at the interfaces: the bit endpoint identity M_sink-M_source=I_m is only asserted as 'the endpoint condition', the complex interface's s_c formula and its C^{⊗m}-on-every-role endpoint corrections are omitted, and the complex deficit (eta_c, sigma) is assumed rather than stated.

steps.note: Present: the fixed linear network on W wires from triples of [h], with the exchange (x,y)->(-y,x) and every scratch wire restored, derived through the eight-row schedule. Missing: h=100, N=binom(h,3)^3, m=h^3 and the indexing of the data by a in T^3, which is a borderline omission.
The plan has a common frame per gate commuting with the pointwise gate, the implemented operator D_out S D_in^{-1}, and edges costing only a change of frame.
Nondegenerate labels in a fixed m-dimensional space built from triple indicators; every edge joins comparable labels; the only decrease is central 3->4, losing h.
S1.1.4.4 states that rank equals dimension change except at the N source edges 2P_{U_a} of rank one. The projection fact P_V-P_U of rank dim V-dim U is only implicit, so this is somewhat thin.
The plan has sources N, sinks Wm-N, the signed sum Wm-2N, Ic decreasing edges of loss h, L=Ich, the absolute sum Wm-2N+2L, and s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b.
L_b/N=100/539 and L_c/N=101/539, both below 1/2, so the deficit N-2L_b>0 and s_b<W_b m.

S1.1.6.3: the endpoint condition gives Phi_{I_m}, the shear H<-H+D, on every row including scratch rows. The identity M_sink(rho(w))-M_source(w)=I_m is carried only as Phi_{I_m}, and its proof from the -P_{U_a} source matrices is absent, so this reconstruction is thin.
A=E_1 Pi E_2, triangular parts in O(V), exactly a interchanges per rank-a edge, hence s recursive calls per node.
Children of volume V/W, F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1), eta_b>20·2^{-50} with m^{1-2^{-50}}>m(1-20·2^{-50})>m(1-eta), tau=1-2^{-50}, F_k=O(e^tau). log m<20 is used implicitly rather than stated.

central.summary: The plan reconstructs the whole central chain: the bank-exchange network, frames, nested labels, rank as dimension change, the budget Wm-2N+2L with s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b, the strict saving from L/N=100/539<1/2, the shear endpoint, edges as interchanges, and the recurrence to e^tau with tau=1-2^{-50}. The weakest links are C7, where the endpoint identity is carried only as Phi_{I_m} without the -P_{U_a} source matrices, and C1, where h=100, N and m are not specified.
